subject: [PATCH v9 08/32] mm: recognize PMD swap entries in the softleaf layer

2026-11-05.patch_summary: This patch allows the Linux kernel to recognize and handle PMD (Page Map Directory) swap entries in the softleaf layer, which is responsible for decoding non-present PMDs. The patch adds a new function `pmd_is_swap_entry()` to check if a PMD entry encodes an actual swap entry, and modifies existing functions to correctly handle swap entries. This change prepares the kernel for installing swap entries directly into PMDs, rather than first splitting them into PTE-level swap entries.
